text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break, while walking 
around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Hasty Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hungry~, food, food, hurry up... 
—Eep!?

A student hurrying down the stairs slipped 
violently! Watch out—

In that instant, Yaeno Muteki darted out 
like a gale, caught the student midair, 
and landed as softly as a falling leaf.

text_block_list.name: Hasty Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you so much, Yaeno-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad you're not injured. Be more 
careful from now on.
choice_data_list:
That was some impressive agility, wasn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...This is entirely the fruit of your 
guidance, Trainer-dono."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If it had been the me of the past, 
catching someone so softly without either 
of us getting injured would have likely 
been difficult.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And above all else— the reason I could act 
without hesitation in the moment was 
because my daily training keeps my mind 
sharp.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I would like to offer my 
heartfelt gratitude to the master who 
guides me. Osu!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, to have refined my body to this 
degree without realizing it is genuinely 
unexpected. Techniques that were once 
impossible... might just work now."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, would you accompany me? To 
be the recipient of a true atemi "kata"... 
unleashed from a tenacious body and supple 
springs.

At any rate, above all, it was great that 
Yaeno Muteki could feel her own growth.
